items.text: Hiyo ndiyo sababu hadi leo Mbwa hukimbiza magari ili achungulie ndani kuona kama atampata dereva mwenye chenji yake.

translation_en.text:
That is why, even
today, Dog runs
towards a car to peep
inside and find the
driver who owes him his

items.text: Nilipomsikia yule mwanamume mwenye mandevu akisema, “Etabo yuko wapi?” Nikalia zaidi. “Lakini sitaki kwenda na wewe!” Nikasema kwa kikweukweu. Nikamtoroka.

translation_en.text:

thick beard saying, "Where is
Etabo?" I cried even harder.
"But I do not want to go with you!" I

I ran away from him.

translation_en.text:
Years ago, a group of horned
animals decided to have a big
party high up in the mountains.
They only invited other animals
with horns. No one else.

clever when he was allowed
into the party. The problem was
that the party was taking place
close to the sun.

commanded, "Grab that pig and
throw him down to earth."
They grabbed the pig and threw
him down to earth.

see the pig's flat snout,
because it's been that way ever
since.

started shouting:

Your maize is all gone!
And he jumped up and
ran away.

appeared and found
the monkey trying to
run away. But he has a
long tail and it was
stopping him.

tail off and told him:

that we cut off your tail!

monkey for lunch.

candy.

care about other people.

questions. Then the old woman
said, "Come carry me to my
house and I will tell you what to

disgusting sores of yours."

a tribe called the Munda decided to
kill the suns.

able to kill six of the suns.

translation_en.text:
Meanwhile, on the other side of the sky,

Sun was ready to leave her sister.

She kissed the moon goodbye and went home.

The mountains put on their pretty green dresses.

translation_en.text:
The large snake heard someone
weeping. He slithered out and saw
the beautiful Tasneem. He
swallowed the makgabe and
Tasneem whole.

items.text: Tasneem alibakisha tu nyumba ya nyanyake kukimbilia. Moyo wake ulikuwa mzito. Aliwaza kuwa hakuna aliyetaka kumshughulikia msichana aliyenuka vibaya.

translation_en.text:
Tasneem had only her
grandmother's house to go to. Her
heart was heavy. She thought
nobody wanted to look after a bad
smelling girl.

grandmother did not send her away.
She washed Tasneem, and her
makgabe, making everything smell
sweetly.

translation_en.text:
Tasneem stayed with her
grandmother for many years.
One day the son of a very rich chief
asked Tasneem to marry him.

marriage and asked her to come
back to live in their house.

grandmother to come and live with
her in the house of this rich chief
and his son.

hurried to the riverbank, dark
clouds began gathering in the sky. A
heavy storm was coming.

Elephant, I asked you to
stop the noise, not to
kill the frogs. And the
elephant was put in
prison for many years!

translation_en.text:
But too soon the holidays were over and the children had to go back to the city.

Nyar-Kanyada gave Odongo a cap and Apiyo a sweater. She packed food for their journey.

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Siku moja wazazi walimtuma Nonkungu akaishi na mjombake tajiri. Mamake alimtengenezea Nonkungu mkufu wa shanga na rinda alilolirembesha kwa shanga.

translation_en.text:
One day her parents decided to
send her to stay with her rich Uncle
Mtonyama.
Nonkungu's mother made a special
skirt with ribbon, buttons and
beads.
She also made a beautiful bead
necklace for Nonkungu.
Then she sent her off to her uncle's
village.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p2; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Yule msichana akasema, “Rinda lako ni zuri na mkufu wako unapendeza. Hebu nivae nione zitakavyonikaa.” Nonkungu alimpa rinda na mkufu.

translation_en.text:
Before they had gone very far, the
young girl said, "Your skirt is so
beautiful and your beads are so
pretty. Please let me try them on."
So Nonkungu took off her skirt and
beads and gave them to the young
girl.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p5; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Msichana huyo alipovaa nguo za Nonkungu, Nonkungu aligundua kwamba alikuwa na mkia! Yule msichana alikuwa Imbulu.

translation_en.text:
When the girl took off her rags and
changed into Nonkungu's clothes,
Nonkungu saw that the young girl
had a tail!
Nonkungu was afraid.
She knew now that the young girl
was really an imbulu.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p6; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Nonkungu alipomwambia amrudishie rinda na mkufu, Imbulu alisema, “Wacha niendelee kuvaa kidogo."

translation_en.text:
They walked on together.
"Please give me back my skirt and
my beads," asked Nonkungu.
But the imbulu answered, "Let me
wear them until we get to that
tree."
She pointed to a tree on the hill.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p7; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

claims.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p7; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Walipofika kwenye boma, Imbulu aliwaambia wenyeji kwamba Nonkungu alikuwa akimfuata siku nzima. "Nataka aniondokee.” Nonkungu aliaibika akajificha.

translation_en.text:
When they reached the hut, the
imbulu pushed Nonkungu back and
called to the women sitting by the
hut.
"Look at this girl wearing rags. She
has been following me all day. I
wish she would go away," said the
imbulu.
Nonkungu was so ashamed and so
frightened that she ran hid in the
kraal.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p10; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

claims.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p10; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Imbulu alimwambia Mtonyama, “Mimi ni mpwa wako, Nonkungu. Wazazi wamenituma niishi nawe." Walimfurahia sana huku Nonkungu akilala nje.

translation_en.text:
Then the imbulu went to Uncle
Mtonyama's hut. She said sweetly,
"I am your niece, Nonkungu. My
parents sent me to stay with you."
Mtonyama welcomed the young
girl. He and his family were very
kind to the imbulu.
But poor Nonkungu had to sleep in
the kraal and share the dog's food.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p11; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

claims.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p11; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Nonkungu aliimba: Matatizo matatizo! Wazazi walinituma, Kwa mjomba Mtonyama, Kakutana na imbulu, Nguo zangu kachukua, Matatizo matatizo!

translation_en.text:
During the day Nonkungu went to
the fields, hid in the corn, and sang:
"Oh misery me, misery me.
I was sent by my father and mother
to stay with my Uncle Mtonyama.
On the way I met an imbulu and she
took my skirt and my beads.
Oh misery me, misery me."

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p12; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Imbulu alikuwa na hofu. Alijua mkia wake ungetamani maziwa. Aliufunga mkia na kuukazia kwenye mwili wake.

translation_en.text:
The imbulu was worried. She did
not want to jump over the ditch.
She knew that her tail would be
thirsty for the sour milk.
So she went into a hut and tied her
tail to her body as tightly as she
could. Then she took her place with
the other girls.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p16; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

claims.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p16; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

items.label: beta

can_do: B2.READ: Understand authentic sentences of level B2
items.text: Ilipokuwa zamu ya Imbulu kuruka, mkia wake ulifunguka ukamvuta chini, chini, chini kwenye shimo la maziwa.

translation_en.text:
One girl after another jumped over
the ditch.
At last it was the imbulu's turn.
She tried to jump high over the
ditch, but her tail broke loose.
The imbulu's tail pulled her down,
down, down into the sour milk.

sources.locator: raw/asp/sw/0251_nonkungu-na-imbulu.md p17; Text: Alan Kenyon, Viv Kenyon; Illustration: Wiehan de Jager; Translation: Mutugi Kamundi

translation_en.text:
The day before Christmas, my
mother woke me up earlier than
usual.
She asked me to fetch
the big shopping basket she
always carried to the market.

At the open-air market there
were many parents with their
children.
They were buying new clothes
and stocking up on food.

items.text: Mwanamke yule mkongwe alimshukuru. Alisema, "Utapata msituni vitu vingi vya ajabu, lakini usichukuwe vyovyote. Ila tu ulete mzizi utakaopata."

translation_en.text:
The old woman thanked him. She
said, "You will find many wonderful
things in the forest, but don't take
any of these things. Only bring back
the root that you find."

items.text: Alipokuwa amemaliza kula, alikumbuka alichoambiwa na yule mwanamke mkongwe. Alikumbuka kwamba aliambiwa achukuwe tu mzizi. Aliutafuta mzizi, lakini hakuuona.

When he had finished, he
remembered what the old woman
had told him. He remembered that
the old woman had said he must
only take the root. He looked
around for the root, but he couldn't
